product.name: Catalog & PIM
product.description: Headless item data for any website: items of any kind (physical goods, services, digital, rentals) with merchant-defined types, statuses, custom fields and scheduled publishing; variants with option pools, prices in minor units, private cost and stock; attributes with facets; a collections tree; brands; media by URL or storage key; CSV import with a dry-run diff and conflict policy; tokened, cacheable shopping feeds; and the catalog REST API. Publishes the standard item, inventory and price events. All data lives in the merchant's own database.

elements.name: Items
elements.description: Items of any kind with merchant-defined item types, statuses, custom fields, translations, SEO fields and scheduled publishing; public listing with filters, sorts and cursor pages. Limited by items.max_items.

elements.name: Variants & stock
elements.description: Variant matrix per item: option dimensions, per-item option pools, uniqueness rules, per-variant price, compare-at price, private cost, SKU, barcode and stock; atomic stock reservations and stock that follows order.placed@1, order.cancelled@1 and order.refunded@1.

elements.name: Attributes & filters
elements.description: Attribute definitions (text, number, boolean, select, multi-select) with options and units, filter visibility, card position, per-collection scope and conditional visibility; facet counts for filters.

elements.name: Collections
elements.description: Categories and collections as a tree with a depth limit, manual ordering, marketing copy, SEO fields and a visibility cascade.

elements.name: Brands
elements.description: Brand registry with logos, descriptions and optional scoping to collections.

elements.name: Media
elements.description: Images and videos per item and variant, referenced by URL or by a key in the merchant's storage, with count limits, a responsive size ladder and alt-text templates. With the storage connector connected (optional), presigned uploads straight to the merchant's own bucket with type and size limits, and signed links for private keys.

elements.name: Import & export
elements.description: CSV templates and exports with configurable columns; imports with column mapping, row validation, a dry-run diff and a conflict policy (skip, overwrite or fail) guarded by item versions; images by URL.

elements.name: Feeds
elements.description: Shopping and marketing feeds (XML, CSV, TSV, JSON) generated from settings-driven field mapping and condition mapping, served at tokened public URLs with cache headers and ETags.

elements.name: Catalog API
elements.description: Server-to-server REST read and write access with the website's sk_ key: write scope, separate read and write rate limits, private cost exposure; metered per request.

plans.name: Starter
plans.description: Items, variants and stock, attributes, collections, brands, media (uploads when storage is connected) and the API; import/export and feeds as add-ons.
